world.text: French Revolutionary Wars: Austrian forces, led by 18-year-old Archduke John, defeated two divisions of the French First Republic near Ampfing, Bavaria.
Returning to Buenos Aires with troops who fought in the Cisplatine War, Juan Lavalle deposed provincial governor Manuel Dorrego, reigniting the Argentine Civil Wars.
Soviet politician Sergei Kirov was assassinated at the Smolny Institute in Leningrad.
The musical Flower Drum Song by Rodgers and Hammerstein premiered on Broadway.
A period of political and economic reforms in the Socialist Republic of Croatia came to an end as the League of Communists of Yugoslavia decided to purge the state's reformist leadership.
